profile.title: PROFILE
profile.lead: I’m Arsenij, a front-end developer working in Shopify app technical support.
profile.desc: I’ve helped 100+ Shopify stores resolve widget and checkout issues. My work includes reproducing bugs, investigating theme scripts and app integrations, and fixing cart, variant and storefront behavior. I work with React, TypeScript, JavaScript and CSS, and was the main front-end developer on Alcemi Shopping Agent. I also take on Shopify customizations and front-end tasks for store owners and agencies.
